pipeline.completionObserver: one asynchronous queue-fence observer; counts only its captured submission watermark

cadence.measurement: Frames covered by resolved asynchronous GPU queue fences; max 2 outstanding. Notification timestamps are CPU delivery times, not individual GPU timestamps or display scanout.
cadence.targetDefinition: At least 30 confirmed GPU-completed frames in every whole second of a 120-second window. Notification gaps are reported separately; individual frame latency is not inferred from batched callbacks.
cadence.scope: Live forecast, approved beachPose and production adaptive settings. Measured before recording; this short check does not replace the 120-second gate.

trace.note: CPU values measure JavaScript encoding; GPU pass timestamps sample one frame per second where supported. framePassSpanMs is the first-to-last instrumented GPU pass span, not a sum of overlapping pass times; excludes work outside those passes. Times are relative to timeOrigin. No display/thermal attribution.

gpuTiming.clock: Native renderer performance.now(); same clock as trace.at and completed-frame timedWindow.

selection.rule: Only native-clock samples inside the completed FPS window; warmup, captures and flagged compression-calibration samples excluded.

reasons: At least 40 finite GPU frame-pass span samples are required.

framePassSpan.definition: First-to-last instrumented GPU pass timestamp span. It is not a sum of overlapping pass durations and excludes work outside instrumented passes.

output.dprDisclosure: Output dimensions changed during the run; adaptive DPR can change GPU cost. This is not a fixed-resolution comparison.
output.thresholdScope: Drift describes the measured adaptive run at its actual output sizes; it does not certify equal-resolution or equal-temperature hardware performance.

historicalRC11.windows: First/last 20 populated samples per pass from the historical RC11 report, including startup; not the same clock window or controlled device temperature/DPR as this run.

totalFrameSpanComparison.reason: The accepted RC11 upload has no frame-pass span timestamps. Per-pass durations are never summed to invent a total or certify the +1.0 ms budget.
